compiled_state.title: Consolidate project-setup skills into resume-aware /dso:onboarding with phase-scoped prompt files
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context

The DSO project-setup workflow is fragmented across four user-invocable skills (/dso:init, /dso:onboarding, /dso:architect-foundation, /dso:generate-claude-md). Users — both project maintainers running setup for the first time and returning users coming back after editing a config artifact — do not know which skill to invoke first or whether re-running is safe. Each skill's SKILL.md is monolithic; conditional sections (stack-specific, CI-platform-specific, design-system-specific, infra-specific) load on every invocation regardless of relevance, inflating per-invocation context cost. The current /dso:onboarding SKILL.md is over 1,800 lines.

User impact today: a maintainer who edits workflow-config.yaml after onboarding has no obvious way to regenerate CLAUDE.md short of re-running everything; a returning user is forced through the entire Socratic dialog from scratch even when only one phase's output is stale; new users face the "which skill first?" cognitive tax.

This epic consolidates the four skills into a single resume-aware /dso:onboarding skill, decomposes conditional content into phase-scoped prompt files at skills/onboarding/prompts/ (loaded only when the phase determines the topic applies), and deletes the three subordinate skills.

Definitions: Freshness check = a phase-specific boolean predicate that returns true when the phase's output artifact is present AND structurally valid; defined per-phase in the SC7 contract table. Enforcement scaffolding = the set of files provisioned by the current /dso:architect-foundation skill (git hook scripts, review-gate config files, CI ruleset entries, fitness-function templates referenced from ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md). SUB-AGENT-GUARD = the block at the top of plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md that returns the literal error "ERROR: /dso:onboarding requires main session; invoke directly." when dispatched via the Task tool. Phase-invocation log = a structured artifact written by the orchestrator at ${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/onboarding-phases.log with fields phase_name, invocation_reason, outcome per row.

## Success Criteria

- SC1: Running /dso:onboarding on a fully set-up project (all four phase artifacts present and pass their freshness checks) writes no files and surfaces no dialog questions. Verified in-session: SHA256 of all four phase artifact files (workflow-config.yaml, project-understanding.md, the enforcement-scaffolding file set, CLAUDE.md) match pre-run and post-run; phase-invocation log shows all four phases with outcome=noop.
- SC2: Running /dso:onboarding after editing workflow-config.yaml re-renders only CLAUDE.md. SHA256 of project-understanding.md and each enforcement-scaffolding file unchanged; SHA256 of CLAUDE.md differs. Phase-invocation log shows generate-claude-md outcome=executed with invocation_reason=dependent_artifact_changed.
- SC3: Running /dso:onboarding after deleting project-understanding.md (precondition: workflow-config.yaml and CLAUDE.md present and fresh) runs only the dialogue and architect-foundation phases. Post-run: workflow-config.yaml and CLAUDE.md SHA256 unchanged; project-understanding.md and enforcement-scaffolding files written. Phase-invocation log shows exactly four entries: init outcome=noop, dialogue outcome=executed, architect-foundation outcome=executed, generate-claude-md outcome=noop.
- SC4: The three previously-user-invocable skills (/dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, /dso:generate-claude-md) no longer appear in `claude plugin list` output, and their directories under plugins/dso/skills/ are absent.
- SC5: Phase files in skills/onboarding/phases/<phase>.md are <=80 non-blank, non-comment lines each. Conditional dialogue and behavioral content for each conditional axis (stack, CI platform, design system, infrastructure type, plus any others identified during extraction) is decomposed into one or more skills/onboarding/prompts/<topic>.md files, loaded via Read only when the executing phase determines the topic applies.
- SC6: Cross-references in CLAUDE.md, plugins/dso/docs/**/*.md, and other skills' SKILL.md files are updated. `grep -rn "dso:init\|dso:architect-foundation\|dso:generate-claude-md" plugins/ .claude/ CLAUDE.md` returns zero matches.
- SC7: A freshness-check contract documented at plugins/dso/docs/onboarding-resume-contract.md containing a markdown table whose rows are the four phases and whose columns are output_artifact, freshness_predicate, dependent_inputs, re-run_trigger.
- SC8: The <SUB-AGENT-GUARD> is preserved on the new /dso:onboarding SKILL.md. Verified by dispatching /dso:onboarding via the Agent tool with subagent_type: "general-purpose" and asserting the returned text contains the literal string "ERROR: /dso:onboarding requires main session; invoke directly.".
- SC9: A behavioral test at tests/scripts/test-onboarding-resume.sh exercises each freshness predicate against a fixture project across four cases: (a) all artifacts fresh -> all phases no-op; (b) workflow-config.yaml modified -> only generate-claude-md executes; (c) project-understanding.md deleted -> dialogue and architect-foundation execute; (d) CLAUDE.md deleted -> only generate-claude-md executes. Test asserts on the phase-invocation log artifact and passes in CI.

## Dependencies

None. Supersedes jira-dig-1567 (narrower scope — "Integrate Claude's init skill into onboarding"). Relates to dso-zj3r (skills/prompts token-usage optimization — broader parent goal) and f6ad-6cad (/dso:next zero-friction auto-router — adjacent UX layer).

## Approach

Replace /dso:onboarding's SKILL.md with a thin orchestrator that runs four phases (init, dialogue, architect-foundation, generate-claude-md) in order, each gated by a presence + phase-specific freshness predicate. The orchestrator writes the phase-invocation log artifact for verification. Inline the deleted skills' logic into skills/onboarding/phases/<phase>.md (≤80 non-blank, non-comment lines each). Decompose conditional sections into skills/onboarding/prompts/<topic>.md files loaded via Read only when the phase determines the topic applies. Delete the three subordinate skill directories. Update cross-references in CLAUDE.md, plugins/dso/docs/MIGRATION-TO-PLUGIN.md, and other skills (roadmap, dryrun, anti-patterns.md). Onboarding remains interactive-only (existing <SUB-AGENT-GUARD> preserved); phases may dispatch sub-agents internally for codebase analysis.

## Scenario Analysis

- Phase gate skips dependent phase when artifact exists but is structurally incomplete (critical, runtime): A truncated artifact from a prior session interrupt may be treated as complete by a presence-only freshness check, causing a dependent phase to skip and leaving the project in a silently broken state.
- Missing prompts/ directory causes all lazy-load attempts to fail on fresh plugin install (critical, configuration): If skills/onboarding/prompts/ is omitted from the plugin distribution, every lazy-load fails — fail-open produces incorrect output, fail-closed aborts onboarding.
- Freshness predicate evaluates stale on file-only edits inside artifact sections (high, runtime): Hand-editing whitespace or comments triggers full re-run because mtime/hash check has no notion of "no semantic change."
- Lazy-load routing picks wrong prompt file on ambiguous stack signal (high, runtime): Polyglot repos (e.g., package.json + pyproject.toml) cause the wrong stack-specific prompts to load.
- Prompt-file Read failure silently skips conditional content (high, runtime): A phase Reading a missing prompt file without an explicit guard generates output missing the conditional sections with no warning.
- Skills that name deleted skills fail at invocation time, not at reference-scan time (high, deployment): Dynamic skill-name construction (variable interpolation) evades the SC6 grep and fails at runtime.
- Malformed workflow-config.yaml causes freshness check to throw instead of falling back (high, configuration): YAML syntax errors from hand-edits abort the entire skill mid-run rather than emitting a helpful malformed-config message.
- Hand-edited project-understanding.md loses required section headers (high, configuration): User edits remove sections that downstream phases depend on; phase silently receives wrong values and generates incorrect scaffolding.
- CI-platform-specific prompt loaded based on file presence rather than active platform (medium, configuration): Stale .github/workflows/ after CI migration causes the wrong CI prompts to load.

## Cross-Epic Interactions

- Architect-foundation phase = integration point for stack/CI/architecture additions. Six open epics (622a-3955 Azure DevOps, 70d5-37ee Java, 6add-c1fc Semgrep CI, ee22-4785 .NET, f06e-9c43 language type validation, dfa1-f9fd loosely coupled architecture) add stack-specific, CI-platform-specific, security-tool, or architectural-principle content to architect-foundation. Constraint: those epics' content must land as skills/onboarding/prompts/<topic>.md files following this epic's decomposition pattern; this epic's phase-conditional Read mechanism is the canonical extension point.
- CLAUDE.md generation = integration point for new repository rules and downstream introspection. Shared with 4911-c7ba (reviewer rubric expansion adding pipefail/mktemp/BASH_SOURCE rules), dso-q0lo (prevent doc explosion — quality enforcement), dso-uvyl (implementation-plan migration awareness — CLAUDE.md introspection). Constraint: the generate-claude-md phase output must remain compatible with downstream skills that read CLAUDE.md by section.
- Plugin skill registry shape changes. Shared with d97a-6bb7 (/dso:doctor health check) and a8e8-0b23 (specialized skill/agent authoring sub-agent). Constraint: skills that audit or generate the plugin skill registry must be updated to recognize the consolidated onboarding structure (3 deletions, new phases/ and prompts/ subdirectories).
- Brainstorm/preplanning attestation patterns. Shared with c183-ed2a (brainstorm completeness attestation) and d63f-2c74 (atomicity-check on AC generation). Constraint: the new phase-invocation log artifact must not interfere with future attestation/atomicity validation; log schema in SC7 contract doc should be referenceable by those epics.
- dso-config.conf config-gating syntax. Shared with dso-0wi2 (project-level config flags). Constraint: phase-conditional and topic-conditional logic must align with the project-level config flag naming and resolution order established by dso-0wi2.
- Token usage of new prompt files. Shared with dso-zj3r (skills/prompts token-usage optimization). Constraint: new prompts/<topic>.md files become candidates for dso-zj3r's audit; maintain reuse-friendly structure (avoid duplicated headers/preambles across topics).
- Sprint story-closure forcing function. Shared with a154-98de (PRECONDITIONS degradation channel + sprint forcing function). Constraint: sprint must observe all four phase outputs and degrade gracefully when phases are skipped.

### Planning Intelligence Log

- Web research (Step 2.6): not triggered
  - Bright-line conditions that fired: none (internal refactor; no external integration, unfamiliar dependency, security/auth, novel architecture, performance/scalability, or migration/compatibility signal)
- Scenario analysis (Step 2.75): triggered
  - Scenarios surviving blue team filter: 9 (of 18 red team findings)
- Practitioner-requested additional cycles: none
- Follow-on scrutiny (Step 0): not triggered
- Feasibility resolution (Step 2.5): not triggered
- LLM-instruction signal (Step 5): triggered — keyword: skill file modifications (bot-psychologist dispatch skipped via graceful degradation: structural refactor, no draft prompt text or LLM-instruction content authored)
- Scale context (Step 0): not applicable (developer-tooling skill refactor; no volume-sensitive decision)
